title: Stages of Clarity
subtitle: Discerning, Vigilant, Resolute, Enlightened
text: Clarity is the Church's measure, unlocked only by the Clarity Ascension pledge. A purifying candidate must first reach full Purity and perform Closed Vein; a healthy novitiate must fulfill all five service vows. Either route then offers Consecrated Copper at the Podium before the pledge. Raise Clarity through observances, accepted Altar offerings, and the path's rites. Each stage grants its Still Arts automatically.
